config.visibleores.title: Visible Ores
config.visibleores.enabled.tooltip: When off, the mod does not change any texture.
config.visibleores.ore.enabled.tooltip: Turns the alternate texture of this ore on or off.
config.visibleores.dimension.tooltip: Where the alternate texture is used. The End is never affected.
config.visibleores.height_limit.tooltip: When on, the alternate texture is used only between the Y levels below.
config.visibleores.min_y.tooltip: Lowest Y level (inclusive) that uses the alternate texture.
config.visibleores.max_y.tooltip: Highest Y level (inclusive) that uses the alternate texture.
config.visibleores.texture.tooltip:
Standard: flat textures of the Vanilla Tweaks ore pack.
Fancy: animated and emissive textures; connected with Continuity.
Custom: textures from the resource pack chosen below.
config.visibleores.custom_pack.tooltip:
A pack from your resourcepacks folder that replaces this ore's texture.
It is read directly, so does not need to be enabled in the Resource Packs screen.
config.visibleores.blue_debris.tooltip: Uses the blue Netherite texture variants (Standard or Fancy).
config.visibleores.keybinds.master.toolt: Turns all texture changes of the mod on or off.
config.visibleores.keybinds.ore.tooltip: Turns the alternate texture of this ore on or off.
config.visibleores.screen.edit.tooltip: Texture, dimension and height settings of this ore.
config.visibleores.screen.reset.tooltip: Restores the default settings of this ore.
config.visibleores.screen.reset_all.mess: Every ore goes back to its default settings. Keybinds are kept.
config.visibleores.screen.master_off: The mod is turned off, so none of these settings apply.
config.visibleores.keybinds.hint: Click a key button, then press a key. Esc removes the key.
config.visibleores.keybinds.duplicate: This key is also used by another toggle of the mod.
config.visibleores.blue_debris.custom_to: Blue variants exist only for the Standard and Fancy textures, so this has no effect with a Custom pack.
config.visibleores.preview.approximate: The pack is read directly from its files. After you press Done its full model is loaded, and the preview becomes exact.
config.visibleores.picker.title: Resource Pack · %s
config.visibleores.picker.empty: No resource packs found in the resourcepacks folder
config.visibleores.picker.open_folder.to: Put a pack into this folder, then come back: the list refreshes automatically.
config.visibleores.picker.none.descripti: No pack is used, the ore keeps its vanilla texture.
config.visibleores.apply.tooltip:
Block: placed blocks in the world.
Item: the item in the inventory, in hand and on the ground.
Item and Block: both.
config.visibleores.blocks_only.tooltip: Applies only to placed blocks, so it does nothing while only Item is selected.
config.visibleores.texture.tooltip_basic:
Standard: textures of the Vanilla Tweaks packs.
Custom: textures from the resource pack chosen below (placed blocks only).
config.visibleores.preview.item_no_world: A simplified preview: the real item is shown once you are in a world.
